Ten Beans, One Rabbit

SSF-MS7-L1-13001400-MSMATH7-STP-LAT

THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The judges' card

As you record, the four numbers fill in. Take the percent off the price. Then find how much more you sold, in percent.

$5FULL PRICE
20%OFF TODAY
80SOLD IN JULY
100SOLD IN AUGUST
THE PRICEHOW MANY SOLD
THE SCENE

You sell a cold cacao drink at the school market. Cacao is the bean that chocolate comes from. Today three judges will hear about your drink. You must fill the judges' card, and four people each have one number.

THE HISTORY

Your drink comes from cacao. The Aztec people grew cacao in Mexico long ago. They used cacao beans as money. A rabbit cost about ten beans.
